# agentic-comments

Comment threads anchored to any content, from people and agents.

Keywords: comments,threads,mentions,annotations,collaboration,agents,yjs.

- SDK: import { Comments, stamp, textAnchor } from "agentic-comments".
- Threads live on a Yjs document and merge across replicas.
- The CLI and MCP server are not built yet.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-comments
